notes: kb/Work PB65 (2026-08-18): ONE screen (DataBinder.ScreenRepositoryIntrinsicName) asked by every declaration funnel — data-name, condition-name, index-name, file-name, paragraph/section name — rejects (COBOL1649) a user-defined word spelling an intrinsic-function-name the REPOSITORY identifies (FUNCTION name INTRINSIC, or every catalogued name under FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC); LENGTH/RANDOM/SIGN/SUM are reserved words already. A catalogued name the REPOSITORY does not identify stays a legal user-defined word (SQRT as a table, MOD as an item — the golden's control) and its FUNCTION-less spelling a data reference. Editions: the REPOSITORY function-specifier is 2002+ (85 has no REPOSITORY). retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.cs#ScreenRepositoryIntrinsicName (kb/Work PB1083 renamed the screen to the one declaration funnel DataBinder.DeclareUserWord) EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10: in force at 85, in the part the 1985 standard states (the leave and the LENGTH, RANDOM, SUM exception; the REPOSITORY exception and SIGN as a function-name are 2002+): §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 SR1 'Function-names, system-names, and user-defined words form intersecting sets. The same COBOL word may be used as a function-name, as a system-name, and as a user-defined word.' and §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 SR2 'The COBOL words LENGTH, RANDOM, and SUM may not be used as a system-name or as a user-defined word regardless of context.'
